# vendor/

`dtcstamp.py` — the stamp format's reference library, one file, standard library
only. Copied unchanged from <https://github.com/zalmoxes-laran/dtcstamp>, tag
`v0.1.3` (commit `98463c4`), sha256
`99ee21c4768750a09648ddb9ab6c67418b4c1c7c137c715ec61db60054aca70f`.
Licence: Apache 2.0, in `LICENSE-dtcstamp`.

`dtc_stamp_ms.py` imports an installed `dtcstamp` when Metashape's Python finds
one with the 0.1.3 API (`note_parent_seen`), and this copy otherwise.
